documentation.content: The fire ingest (task ingest-fires on hawanama-ingest) finished with status failed. `error=invalid_key` means NASA rejected the FIRMS map key: request a new key at https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/map_key/, add it as a new version of the FIRMS_MAP_KEY secret, roll hawanama-ingest and hawanama with `--update-secrets=FIRMS_MAP_KEY=FIRMS_MAP_KEY:latest`, then run the firms-fire-ingest scheduler job. `error=all_sources_failed` means every satellite request failed (NASA outage or network); it usually recovers on the next 3-hourly run. Full runbook: apps/api/app/services/fires.py.
